connector.name: MCP by cueapi.ai
connector.registryDescription: Schedule agent work and report write-once outcomes via CueAPI from any MCP host.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace ai.cueapi. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CUEAPI_API_KEY

env.name: CUEAPI_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the CueAPI base URL for self-hosted instances. Defaults to https://api.cueapi.ai
